title: STT scene bundle manifest (scene.json)
description: The envelope for a multi-stream STT 'scene bundle' (the AV-cockpit profile, docs/spec/sidecar-assets.md). It points at the per-stream packed STT datasets and the non-tile sidecars, and declares the bundle's georeferencing. Authority: scripts/data-generation/av_common.py (write_scene_json) and examples/showcase/src/datasets.ts.

id.description: Stable scene id; matches the bundle directory name.

license.description: SPDX id or license name of the source data.

location.description: Place label. For anchored-local frames this MUST state the anchoring honestly, e.g. 'San Francisco (Waymo world frame, anchored)'.

georef.description: Always present: the map origin the stream geometry is projected/anchored around (see §4). For a `georeferenced` scene, {originLat, originLon} is the authoritative WGS84 origin the local sensor frame was projected from. For an `anchored-local` scene, it is a plausible city lon/lat the source's undisclosed local frame is anchored to, not an authoritative geodetic origin. Which of the two applies to a given scene is not signaled by this object's shape or presence — see §4.1.

objectColors.description: Categorical object-class palette baked into the bundle (mirrors the canonical OBJECT_COLORS). Keys are object categories; values are RGBA [0..255] quads.

lidarColors.description: Optional. Present when lidar is colored by a semantic class (seg_class) rather than a height band. Keys are class names; values RGBA quads.

streams.description: Only present streams appear. Each tiled stream points at a standard packed STT dataset (its manifest.json); the non-tile streams point at sidecar JSON.

url.description: Relative path to a packed STT point dataset (e.g. 'lidar/manifest.json').

splat.description: Splat rendering hint: 'soft' (gaussian point splats) or 'surfel' (oriented surfel columns present).

style.description: Presentation hint naming the extractor mode that produced this archive. The shipping vocabulary is exactly five values: 'world' (--worldbuild — the consolidated cross-sweep cloud carrying world_class / is_dynamic), 'scan' (--scan — the per-return scan-time sweep, always paired with `scan: true`), 'iso' (--contours — the archive holds windowed density iso-line LineStrings, NOT points), 'actors' (the animated half of a --scene-split bundle) and 'stage' (its timeless half, which appears on the `stage` stream). Absent on a plain density-tier bundle. Deliberately not an enum: the render path is chosen from the dataset's own flags, so a reader MUST tolerate an unrecognised value rather than reject the bundle.

densities.description: Alternative lidar variants selectable in the cockpit (e.g. the stage/actors pair in a scene-split bundle), each pointing at its own packed dataset.

id.description: Stable variant id, unique within the array. The shipping ids are the five fixed density tiers ('small', 'medium', 'large', 'ultra', 'full'), the single-variant extractor modes ('surfel', 'world', 'scan', 'iso', 'lod') and the scene-split pair ('stage', 'actors').

radius.description: Fixed-density tiers only: the point radius, in pixels, the cockpit should draw this variant at. Denser tiers ship a SMALLER dot so the cloud reads as structure rather than a solid mass, so this is per-variant and not a scene-wide constant.

radiusMinPixels.description: Fixed-density tiers only: the sub-pixel screen-space floor paired with `radius`.

lod.description: Present and true on the single additive-octree LOD variant (built with --lod): every return is materialized at ONE home zoom, so each level holds only its residual and the client loads the union of levels rather than swapping one whole fixed-density archive for another.

minZoom.description: LOD variants (`lod: true`) only: the coarsest home zoom baked into the archive (--lod-min-zoom).

maxZoom.description: LOD variants (`lod: true`) only: the finest home zoom, where the full-density residual lands (--lod-max-zoom).

url.description: Relative path to a packed STT trips (LineString) dataset.

path.description: Optional lightweight ego polyline (lon/lat/t) for camera-follow without decoding the trips archive.

url.description: Relative path to a packed STT point dataset (one point per tracked object per sample).
Relative path to a packed STT LineString dataset — one per-object trail per tracked object (distinct from `ego`, which is the ego vehicle only).

stage.description: Scene-split bundles only: the STATIC, timeless accumulated surfel cloud (the 'stage'), rendered under the animated lidar 'actors' stream.

url.description: Relative path to a packed STT point dataset built with one full-range temporal bucket.

style.description: Always 'stage' on this stream — see streams.lidar.style for the vocabulary.

static.description: Always true — the stream is temporally constant.

map.description: Optional HD-map streams. Each is a standard packed STT dataset (polygon/line) built with a static, full-scene temporal bucket.

url.description: Relative path to telemetry.json (CAN-bus time series sidecar).
Relative path to cameras.json (camera keyframe sidecar).
